fusions.name: Full Tilt
fusions.desc: Gallops into the target behind a rushing gale, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after.

fusions.name: Trampling Shove
fusions.desc: Drives a thundering gust in a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and knocking each back 3.5 tiles. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Gallop Tempo
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 15 seconds, and you move 20% faster for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Thunder Underfoot

riders.text: the ground goes by at a gallop
you are past before the blow arrives
and your hands keep the hoofbeat

fusions.desc: Raises your Speed by 1, and your Speed ceiling by 1. From bronze rank you move 5% faster, from silver your dodge chance rises by 5%, and from gold you attack 8% faster.
